supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show Emma Stone connecting by RDP from WS-ESTONE-01 to DC-PIN-01 at 13:24 UTC and authenticating there; they do not establish that she created tmp.rwong.

The records do not provide domain-controller account-management auditing or a complete view of activity on DC-PIN-01 around the alert time.

Whether tmp.rwong was added only to Temp-Staff or was granted any other group membership or privileges.

Relevant authentication and session records for the account creator, including DC-PIN-01 activity around the reported creation time.
unrelated_findings: Emma Stone initiated RDP sessions from WS-ESTONE-01 to DC-PIN-01 and FILE-PIN-01; the inventory says remote administration is only performed from WS-RPATEL-01.
